# {{PKG}}

> Zero-dependency JSX SSR renderer for HTMX + Alpine.js. Works on Bun, Node 18+, Cloudflare Workers, and any runtime with Web APIs. No React. No virtual DOM. No client bundle.

## Install & Setup

```bash
bun add {{PKG}}   # or: npm install {{PKG}}
```

```json
// tsconfig.json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "jsxImportSource": "{{PKG}}"
  }
}
```

Files that use JSX must have `.tsx` extension.

---

## Core Concepts

- JSX compiles to plain HTML strings, not React elements.
- `HtmlSafeString` is the safe HTML type — wraps a string that has already been escaped.
- All text interpolated in JSX is **HTML-escaped automatically**.
- `raw(str)` bypasses escaping — only use for server-generated, trusted HTML.
- `children` inside components is a `string` (already rendered HTML), not a React node.

---

## Rendering

### renderPage(factory, opts?)

Full page render. Prepends `<!DOCTYPE html>`. Use for initial page loads.

```tsx
import { renderPage, head, raw } from '{{PKG}}'

const HTML_HEAD = head({
  title: 'My App',
  scripts: [
    'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.10/dist/htmx.min.js',
    'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.15.12/dist/cdn.min.js',
  ],
})

export const handler = async (req: Request): Promise<Response> => {
  const html = await renderPage(() => (
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8" />
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
        {raw(HTML_HEAD)}
      </head>
      <body>
        <h1>Hello</h1>
      </body>
    </html>
  ))
  return new Response(html, { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/html' } })
}
```

### renderToString(factory, opts?)

Fragment render — no DOCTYPE. Use for HTMX partial responses.

```tsx
import { renderToString, isHtmx } from '{{PKG}}'

export const getDashboard = async (req: Request): Promise<Response> => {
  // Return only the updated fragment when HTMX requests a partial
  if (isHtmx(req)) {
    const html = await renderToString(() => <EmailList rows={rows} />)
    return new Response(html, { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/html' } })
  }

  // Full page on direct navigation
  const html = await renderPage(() => (
    <Layout>
      <EmailList rows={rows} />
    </Layout>
  ))
  return new Response(html, { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/html' } })
}
```

### raw(html: string)

Marks a string as trusted HTML. Skips escaping.

```tsx
// head() returns a string — must be wrapped in raw()
{raw(head({ title: 'App' }))}

// Inline CSS block
<style>{raw(`.btn { color: red }`)}</style>

// Pre-rendered HTML from a trusted source
<div>{raw(sanitizedUserContent)}</div>
```

---

## Components

### defineComponent — typed props component

```tsx
import { defineComponent, type Children } from '{{PKG}}'

export const Button = defineComponent<{
  children?: Children
  type?: 'button' | 'submit'
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger'
  class?: string
  // Pass-through HTMX attrs explicitly when needed
  'hx-get'?: string
  'hx-target'?: string
  'hx-swap'?: string
}>(({ children, type = 'button', variant = 'secondary', class: className = '', ...attrs }) => {
  const styles = {
    primary:   'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500',
    secondary: 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-100 border-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-800',
    danger:    'bg-red-950 text-red-200 border-red-500 hover:bg-red-900',
  }
  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      class={`inline-flex items-center border px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold ${styles[variant]} ${className}`}
      {...attrs}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  )
})
```

### defineLayout — layout component that wraps children

```tsx
import { defineLayout } from '{{PKG}}'

// defineLayout is defineComponent + ParentComponent type — children prop is included automatically
export const Layout = defineLayout(({ children }) => (
  <html lang="en">
    <head>
      <meta charset="utf-8" />
      {raw(HEAD_INNER)}
    </head>
    <body class="min-h-screen bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100">
      {children}
    </body>
  </html>
))

// AppShell with typed extra props
export const AppShell = defineLayout<{ active?: 'dashboard' | 'settings' }>(
  ({ children, active }) => (
    <div class="min-h-screen">
      <nav>...</nav>
      <main>{children}</main>
    </div>
  )
)
```

### Usage pattern — compose layouts

```tsx
// Page uses Layout → AppShell → content
export const getDashboard = async (req: Request) => {
  const html = await renderPage(() => (
    <Layout>
      <AppShell active="dashboard">
        <div class="grid gap-6">
          <h1>Inbox</h1>
          <EmailList rows={rows} />
        </div>
      </AppShell>
    </Layout>
  ))
  return new Response(html, { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/html' } })
}
```

---

## HTMX

All HTMX attributes are typed JSX props on every HTML element.

### Inline HTMX — polling, lazy load, live update

```tsx
// Refresh a region on button click
<button
  hx-get="/dashboard"
  hx-target="#email-list"
  hx-swap="outerHTML"
>
  Refresh <span class="htmx-indicator ml-2">...</span>
</button>

// Lazy-load a panel on page load
<div hx-get="/stats" hx-trigger="load" hx-swap="innerHTML">
  <p>Loading...</p>
</div>

// HTMX partial handler
if (isHtmx(req)) {
  return new Response(await renderToString(() => <StatsPanel />), {
    headers: { 'content-type': 'text/html' },
  })
}
```

### Row-level HTMX — clickable table rows

```tsx
{rows.map((row) => (
  <a
    href={`/emails/${row.id}`}
    hx-get={`/emails/${row.id}`}
    hx-target="#email-modal"
    hx-swap="innerHTML"
    class="grid grid-cols-4 px-4 py-3 hover:bg-zinc-900"
  >
    <span>{row.from}</span>
    <span>{row.subject}</span>
    <span>{row.date}</span>
    <Badge tone={row.status === 'processed' ? 'success' : 'danger'}>{row.status}</Badge>
  </a>
))}
<div id="email-modal"></div>
```

### OOB swap — update outside main target

```tsx
// Returns primary content + updates badge counter in the same response
<>
  <EmailDetail email={email} />
  <OOB target="unread-badge">3</OOB>
</>
```

### htmxResponse — response headers

```tsx
return htmxResponse(response, {
  trigger: 'emailAdded',   // HX-Trigger
  redirect: '/dashboard',  // HX-Redirect
  pushUrl: '/dashboard',   // HX-Push-Url
})
```

### Detect HTMX context

```ts
isHtmx(req)         // true if HX-Request header present
isBoosted(req)      // true if hx-boost
hxTarget(req)       // HX-Target header value
hxTrigger(req)      // HX-Trigger header value
hxCurrentUrl(req)   // HX-Current-URL header value
```

---

## Alpine.js

All Alpine directives are typed JSX props.

### State + events

```tsx
// $click is shorthand for x-on:click
<div x-data="{ open: false }">
  <button $click="open = !open">Toggle</button>
  <p x-show="open" x-cloak>Hidden until open</p>
</div>

// x-bind shorthand: x-bind-class → :class equivalent
<div x-bind-class="{ 'bg-red-500': hasError }">...</div>
```

### Global store — storeInit

```tsx
import { storeInit, raw } from '{{PKG}}'

// Emit in <head> or before the component that needs it
{raw(storeInit('cart', { items: [], total: 0 }))}

// Then in any component:
<span x-text="$store.cart.total"></span>
<button $click="$store.cart.items.push(item)">Add</button>
```

Data is safeJson-serialized — `</script>`, U+2028, U+2029 are escaped automatically.

---

## CSRF

Bind CSRF to a `sessionId` to scope the token.

```tsx
import { csrf, CsrfField } from '{{PKG}}'

// Sign (server-side, before rendering the form)
const token = await csrf.sign({ secret: env.SECRET, sessionId: userId })

// Render (auto-injects hidden input)
<form method="post" action="/save">
  <CsrfField token={token} />
  <input name="title" type="text" />
  <button type="submit">Save</button>
</form>

// Verify (in POST handler)
const token = String(form.get('_csrf') ?? '')
const valid = await csrf.verify(token, { secret: env.SECRET, sessionId: userId })
if (!valid) return new Response('Forbidden', { status: 403 })
```

---

## Per-Request Context

Pass data to any component without prop drilling using AsyncLocalStorage.

```tsx
import { withContext, useContext } from '{{PKG}}'

// In request handler
const html = await renderPage(
  () => <Dashboard />,
  { context: { user, db, locale } }
)

// In any deeply nested component
const Dashboard = defineComponent(() => {
  const { user } = useContext<{ user: User; locale: string }>()
  return <h1>Hello, {user.name}</h1>
})
```

---

## Flash Messages

```ts
// On redirect — set flash on Response
flash.set(response, { type: 'success', message: 'Saved!' }, env.SECRET)

// On next request — read and clear
const msg = await flash.get(request, env.SECRET)
if (msg) {
  // { type: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning', message: string }
}
```

---

## Forms helper

```tsx
import { Form, Field, formContext } from '{{PKG}}'

// Pass errors from server validation
const ctx = formContext({ errors: { email: 'Invalid email' }, values: { email: 'bad' } })

const html = await renderPage(
  () => (
    <Form action="/register" method="post">
      <Field name="email" label="Email" type="email" />
      <Field name="password" label="Password" type="password" />
      <button type="submit">Register</button>
    </Form>
  ),
  { context: ctx }
)
```

---

## Security Model

- Text content and attributes: **HTML-escaped by default**, including strings returned by components
- Plain text inside `<script>` / `<style>`: **throws** — use `raw()` for trusted code, `raw(safeJson(x))` for data
- Booleans in `aria-*` / `data-*`: rendered as `"true"` / `"false"`
- `on*` event attributes (`onclick`, `onload`, etc.): **blocked entirely — never emitted**
- URLs in `href`, `src`, `action`, `formaction`: `javascript:`, `data:`, `blob:`, `vbscript:` → replaced with `#`
- Invisible Unicode chars (zero-width space, etc.) stripped from URLs before protocol check
- CSS property values: `"` → `&quot;`, `<>` removed; invalid property names rejected
- Cookie names: RFC 6265 token validation (blocks HTTP header injection)
- CSRF tokens: HMAC-SHA256, timing-safe compare

Use `raw()` only for HTML you generated server-side or sanitized yourself.

---

## TypeScript Types

```ts
import type { Component, ParentComponent, FC, RenderResult, PropsWithChildren, Children } from '{{PKG}}'

// Children: anything htsx can render as a child (use `children?: Children` in props)

// Component with typed props
const Card: Component<{ title: string }> = ({ title }) => (
  <div class="card"><h2>{title}</h2></div>
)

// Layout (children included automatically)
const Layout: ParentComponent = ({ children }) => (
  <main>{children}</main>
)

// defineComponent / defineLayout (preferred — infers return type)
const Box = defineComponent<{ size: 'sm' | 'lg' }>(({ size }) => (
  <div class={size === 'sm' ? 'p-2' : 'p-6'} />
))
```

---

## Common Patterns

### Conditional rendering

```tsx
// Use ternary or && — both work, falsy values are safe
{isLoggedIn ? <UserMenu user={user} /> : <LoginButton />}
{hasError && <ErrorBanner message={error} />}
```

### Lists

```tsx
// .map() returns an array — htsx flattens it automatically
<ul>
  {items.map((item) => (
    <li key={item.id}>{item.name}</li>
  ))}
</ul>
```

### Async components

```tsx
// Async functions work as components
const UserCard = async ({ userId }: { userId: string }) => {
  const user = await db.users.find(userId)
  return <div>{user.name}</div>
}

// Await in the factory
const html = await renderPage(async () => (
  <Layout>
    {await UserCard({ userId: '123' })}
  </Layout>
))
```

### Detecting and returning partials

```tsx
export const getPage = async (req: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> => {
  const rows = await fetchRows(env)

  // HTMX partial — return only what changed
  if (isHtmx(req)) {
    return new Response(
      await renderToString(() => <RowList rows={rows} />),
      { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/html' } }
    )
  }

  // Full page on direct navigation
  return new Response(
    await renderPage(() => (
      <Layout>
        <AppShell>
          <RowList rows={rows} />
        </AppShell>
      </Layout>
    )),
    { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/html' } }
  )
}
```

---

## What NOT to do

- Never use React hooks, useState, useRef, useEffect — they don't exist
- Never import from `{{PKG}}/src/*` — only use the main barrel `{{PKG}}`
- Never return JSX directly from a route handler — always await `renderPage()` or `renderToString()` first
- Never concatenate HTML strings (`'<div>' + x`) — use JSX so escaping is automatic
- Never pass `children` to a component and then access it as a React node — it's already a rendered string
- Never share `cache()` or `Suspense` state across requests without `withContext` — it throws intentionally
